title.zh-CN: 早产儿呼吸困难加重 · 7日龄女婴
title.en: Worsening breathing in a preterm baby · 7-day-old girl

summary.zh-CN: 一名孕33周出头出生、出生体重1.1 kg的早产女婴，在新生儿病房住到第7天时呼吸明显变差，护士请你马上到床旁。
summary.en: A baby girl born just after 33 weeks and weighing 1.1 kg breathes markedly worse on her seventh day in the neonatal unit, and the nurse asks you to come to her cot now.

notes.zh-CN: 依据一篇已发表的单例病例报告改编。1.1.0版依据1.0.0版已记录的事实重写：女婴孕33+3周因母亲重度子痫前期剖宫产，出生体重1.1 kg，生后即气促；早期查体胸廓对称、轻度三凹征、呼吸音粗；用过呼吸支持、肺表面活性物质和静脉营养；生后第2天经右侧贵要静脉置入PICC，尖端位于第3胸椎下缘，之后的胸片描述位置同前；置管第5天呼吸明显加重，发绀、三凹征明显、反应极差，呼吸支持升级；影像示双侧胸腔积液伴肺不张，超声示右侧较多并有少量腹水；胸水淡黄透明，乙醚试验阳性、李凡他试验阴性、培养阴性；胸腔穿刺（每次20–30 mL）并拔除PICC后积液和腹水消退、转回CPAP；住院54天、体重2.4 kg出院，2个月和4个月随访生长发育报告正常。这些事实尚未对照原文全文核对。患儿姓名为化名，医院和日历日期已去除，时间以生后天数和置管天数表示。陪同家属、全部对话、阶段、决策、处置选项、评分和教学要点为教学设计；1.0.0未记录的内容保持未知。保留的不一致：胸水记为“透明”而乙醚试验阳性；1.0.0的影像结论未逐项注明检查方式；置管第5天与7日龄的天数计算方式未说明。1.0.0称漏点、甘油三酯和乳糜微粒“未提供”，本版只说本病例没有这些结果记录，不对原文作出断言。
notes.en: Adapted from one published single-case report. Version 1.1.0 is re-authored from the facts version 1.0.0 records: a girl delivered by caesarean at 33+3 weeks because of severe maternal pre-eclampsia, birth weight 1.1 kg, breathless from birth; an early examination with symmetrical chest movement, mild recession and coarse breath sounds; respiratory support, surfactant and parenteral nutrition; a PICC placed through the right basilic vein on day 2 with its tip at the lower border of T3, described as unchanged on later films; a marked deterioration on catheter day 5 with cyanosis, marked recession and very poor responsiveness, and escalated support; bilateral pleural effusions with atelectasis, more on the right on ultrasound, with a small amount of ascites; pleural fluid pale yellow and clear, ether test positive, Rivalta test negative, culture negative; resolution of the effusions and ascites and a return to CPAP after pleural taps (20–30 mL each) and removal of the PICC; discharge after 54 days in hospital at 2.4 kg, with growth and development reported normal at 2 and 4 months. These facts have not yet been checked against the full article. The baby's name is a pseudonym; hospitals and calendar dates are removed and times are given as days of life and catheter days. The relative, all dialogue, the phases, decisions, management options, scoring and teaching points are teaching design; what 1.0.0 does not record stays unknown. Inconsistencies kept: the fluid is recorded as clear although the ether test was positive; 1.0.0's imaging summary does not say which finding came from which modality; how catheter day 5 and the age of 7 days were counted is not stated. Version 1.0.0 said a leak point, triglycerides and chylomicrons were "not supplied"; this version says only that the case records no such results, without a claim about the article.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 认识到带中心静脉导管的新生儿出现任何恶化都要先想到导管并发症——感染、液体外渗入胸腔和心包压塞，并在床旁立即处理：支持呼吸，停止经该导管输注且不冲管，急查床旁胸片和超声心动图（BAPM框架，2015年发布、2018年修订）。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise that any deterioration of a newborn with a central venous catheter raises catheter complications — infection, extravasation into the chest and tamponade — and act at the cot side: support breathing, stop infusing through the line without flushing it, and get an urgent chest film and echocardiogram (BAPM framework, 2015, revised 2018).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按“尖端位于中心静脉、心脏之外”的目标判断新生儿PICC尖端位置（BAPM 2018；ESPGHAN/ESPEN/ESPR/CSPEN 2018）：把椎体平面视为各指南不尽相同的近似标志，每次拍片记录肢体位置，已经脱出的导管段绝不再送回血管。
learningOutcomes.en: Judge a neonatal PICC tip against the target of a central tip outside the heart (BAPM 2018; ESPGHAN/ESPEN/ESPR/CSPEN 2018), treating vertebral levels as proxies that differ between guidelines, recording the limb position on every film and never pushing catheter that has come out back into the vein.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 处理导管相关胸腔积液：停用并拔除导管；对影响呼吸的积液在超声引导下穿刺，按mL/kg估量抽液量；胸水送细胞计数和分类、甘油三酯、蛋白、葡萄糖和培养；必须拔除中心静脉导管时短期经外周静脉继续营养（NICE NG154，2020）。
learningOutcomes.en: Manage a line-related pleural effusion: take the line out of use and remove it, tap an effusion that compromises breathing under ultrasound with the volume judged in mL/kg, send the fluid for cell count and differential, triglyceride, protein, glucose and culture, and continue nutrition peripherally for a short time when a central line has to come out (NICE NG154, 2020).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 运用儿童乳糜诊断标准——有经口脂肪摄入时甘油三酯 > 1.1 mmol/L，细胞数 ≥ 1000/µL且淋巴细胞 > 80 %（Büttiker 1999），并说明为什么外观清亮、乙醚试验或李凡他试验都不能区分乳糜和漏出的输注液。
learningOutcomes.en: Apply the paediatric chyle criteria — triglyceride > 1.1 mmol/L with oral fat intake, ≥ 1000 cells/µL with > 80 % lymphocytes (Büttiker 1999) — and explain why a clear appearance, an ether test or a Rivalta test cannot separate chyle from leaked infusate.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 把乳糜胸的专门治疗留给确诊且持续的乳糜漏——先无脂喂养，持续漏出时禁食并给予肠外营养，奥曲肽仅是证据不足的选择（Cochrane系统评价2010：没有随机对照试验），并结合解剖和已记录的检查评价报告的乳糜胸诊断及其因果推断。
learningOutcomes.en: Reserve chylothorax treatment for a confirmed, persistent leak — fat-free feeding first, parenteral nutrition with enteric rest if it continues, and octreotide only as an unproven option (Cochrane review 2010: no randomised trials) — and appraise the report's chylothorax label and causal claim against the anatomy and the tests recorded.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 向家属如实说明可能的导管并发症——发生了什么、哪些还不确定、接下来怎么做，把它作为患者安全事件上报，并安排呼吸、生长和发育随访。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain a probable line complication to the family honestly — what happened, what is still uncertain and what will be done — report it as a patient-safety event, and arrange follow-up of breathing, growth and development.

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 孩子喘气越来越费劲，人都发紫了
chiefComplaint.en: She’s struggling more and more to breathe, and she’s gone blue

triageNote.zh-CN: 7日龄女婴，在新生儿病房：孕 33+3 周剖宫产，出生体重 1.1 kg，生后即有气促，用过呼吸支持、肺表面活性物质和静脉营养；生后第 2 天经右上肢置入PICC。今天呼吸明显加重——发绀，三凹征明显，反应极差，家属在床旁。
triageNote.en: 7-day-old girl in the neonatal unit, born by caesarean at 33+3 weeks weighing 1.1 kg, breathless from birth and treated with respiratory support, surfactant and parenteral nutrition; a PICC went into her right arm on day 2. Today her breathing is much worse — cyanosed, with marked recession and very poor responsiveness — and a relative is at the cot side.

personality.zh-CN: 7日龄的早产女婴，不会说话。陪在床旁的家属看到孩子喘得这么厉害，又怕又急，但愿意配合；知道孩子出生和住院的大概经过，说不清医学细节。
personality.en: A 7-day-old premature baby girl who cannot speak. The relative at her cot side is frightened by how hard she is working to breathe but cooperative, and knows the outline of her birth and stay without the medical details.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 家属用日常口语、短句回答；周数和体重照医生说的讲，说不出药名和机器参数；检查结果请医生看病历；不知道的直说说不上来。
speechStyle.en: The relative answers in short, everyday sentences, repeats the weeks and weights the doctors gave, cannot give drug names or machine settings, leaves results to the doctors’ notes, and says plainly when they don’t know.

openingLine.zh-CN: （家属）医生，您快看看她，她喘得越来越厉害，人都发紫了。
openingLine.en: (Relative) Doctor, please look at her — she’s struggling more and more to breathe, and she’s gone blue.

concerns.zh-CN: 她这么小，会不会挺不过去？
concerns.en: She’s so small — will she pull through?

concerns.zh-CN: 以后她还能和别的孩子一样长大吗？
concerns.en: Will she still grow up like other children?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 婴儿：躺在床上，不会说话，呼吸很费力。家属：守在旁边，紧张但配合；只回答被问到的内容；问到检查结果或诊断时，说这要听医生的；病历里没有的事直说不知道，不要编，也不要自己猜是哪根管子出了问题。
actingNotes.en: Baby: lying in her cot, unable to speak, working hard to breathe. Relative: at the cot side, tense but cooperative; answers only what is asked; asked about results or the diagnosis, says that is for the doctors; says plainly when something is not known — never invents it, and never guesses which tube might be to blame.

persona.zh-CN: 孩子的近亲属，具体是哪位亲属未记录，不另加设定；陪在床旁。害怕又着急，说话直白，用日常说法；只讲自己知道或听医生、护士说过的事；记不清的直说，不替医生下结论。
persona.en: A close relative of the baby (which relative is not recorded — add nothing), at her cot side. Frightened and anxious, speaks plainly in everyday words, says only what they know or have heard from the doctors and nurses, admits what they cannot remember and draws no medical conclusions.

label.zh-CN: 生后第7天：呼吸明显加重
label.en: Day 7: her breathing is much worse

description.zh-CN: 生后第 7 天，护士发现她呼吸明显费力、发绀、反应极差，请你立即到床旁。向家属了解病史，查看早期病程记录和PICC置管记录，床旁查体，作答决策 1 并落实它的第一步处理；第一步处理全部到位后，床旁影像结果回报。
description.en: On day 7 of life the nurse finds her working hard to breathe, cyanosed and very poorly responsive, and calls you to the cot side. Take the history from her relative, read the early-course notes and the PICC insertion record, examine her, answer decision 1 and carry out its first steps; once all of them are in place, the bedside imaging comes back.

description.zh-CN: 床旁胸片和超声的报告已可调阅（具体时间未记录）。判断她为什么恶化，作答决策 2 并在床旁落实方案；方案落实后，下一批结果回报。
description.en: The bedside film and ultrasound reports can now be read (their timing is not recorded). Work out why she has deteriorated, answer decision 2 and put its plan into action at the cot side; once it is in place, the next results come back.

description.zh-CN: 穿刺抽出的液体已送检，结果可以调阅（具体时间未记录）。判断这份液体能说明什么，并为她接下来的恢复做计划；决策 3 和决策 4 作答后，报告记录的病程开放。
description.en: The fluid drawn off has been sent and its results can be read (their timing is not recorded). Decide what this fluid can tell you and plan her recovery; once decisions 3 and 4 are answered, the reported course opens.

name.zh-CN: 报告记录的病程与结局

date.zh-CN: 住院 54 天及 2、4 个月随访
date.en: The 54-day admission and the 2- and 4-month follow-up

text.zh-CN: 报告的处理与结局：行胸腔穿刺抽液（每次 20–30 mL）并拔除PICC后，胸腔积液和腹水消退，呼吸支持转回CPAP。住院 54 天，出院时体重 2.4 kg；2 个月和 4 个月随访，生长发育报告正常。报告题目把本例归为PICC所致的极低出生体重儿双侧乳糜胸并腹水。本病例没有记录穿刺次数和侧别、积液消退所用的时间、升级后的呼吸支持方式、超声心动图、血管超声、胸水细胞和生化、血培养或抗生素。
text.en: The report's management and outcome: after pleural taps (20–30 mL each) and removal of the PICC, the pleural effusions and ascites resolved and her respiratory support returned to CPAP. She was discharged after 54 days in hospital weighing 2.4 kg; at follow-up at 2 and 4 months her growth and development were reported normal. The report's title attributes bilateral chylothorax with ascites in this very-low-birth-weight infant to the PICC. This case does not record the number or sides of the taps, how long the fluid took to resolve, the mode of the escalated support, an echocardiogram, a vein scan, the fluid's cells or chemistry, a blood culture or antibiotics.

source.zh-CN: 报告记录（1.0.0版提取，尚未对照原文核对）：胸穿、拔PICC后胸水及腹水消退，转回CPAP；住院54天，体重2.4 kg出院；2、4个月随访生长发育正常；题目：外周穿刺中心静脉置管致极低出生体重儿双侧乳糜胸并腹水；每次抽液20–30 mL见1.0.0决策选项
source.en: From the report as extracted for 1.0.0 (not yet checked against the full article): after the taps and PICC removal the effusions and ascites resolved and she returned to CPAP; 54 days in hospital, discharged at 2.4 kg; growth and development normal at 2 and 4 months; title: PICC-caused bilateral chylothorax with ascites in a very-low-birth-weight infant; the 20–30 mL per tap is from a 1.0.0 decision option

name.zh-CN: 立即停止经PICC的全部输注（不冲管，导管暂留原位）
name.en: Stop everything running through the PICC now (no flushing; leave the line in place for now)

dose.zh-CN: 关闭经PICC的所有输液泵并夹闭导管；不冲管、不回抽冲洗，等影像结果再决定导管去留；需要的液体和药物改由另一条静脉通路给予。
dose.en: Stop every pump running into the PICC and clamp the line; do not flush it; let the imaging decide whether it stays; give any fluids or drugs she needs through other venous access.

response.zh-CN: 经PICC的输注已全部停止，导管暂时保留，等影像结果再决定去留。本病例没有记录当时经PICC输注的是什么，也没有记录何时停用；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Everything through the PICC has stopped; the line stays in for now until the imaging decides its fate. This case does not record what was running through the PICC or when it was stopped; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 升级呼吸支持（提高压力和氧浓度，必要时气管插管机械通气）
name.en: Escalate respiratory support (more pressure and oxygen; intubation and ventilation if needed)

dose.zh-CN: 按呼吸做功和血氧饱和度逐步上调压力和吸入氧浓度；无创支持维持不住时气管插管、机械通气。
dose.en: Step up the pressure and inspired oxygen to her work of breathing and oxygen saturation; intubate and ventilate if non-invasive support cannot hold her.

response.zh-CN: 呼吸支持已经升级。报告记录她的呼吸支持在恶化后逐步升级，具体方式和参数没有记录；本病例不模拟其效果。
response.en: Support stepped up. The report records that her respiratory support was escalated after the deterioration; the mode and settings are not recorded, and the case does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 呼叫新生儿科上级医生到床旁
name.en: Call the neonatal consultant to the cot side

dose.zh-CN: 说明情况（ISBAR）：7日龄早产儿，带PICC，呼吸明显恶化，请上级医生立即到床旁。
dose.en: Hand over in ISBAR form — a 7-day-old preterm baby with a PICC whose breathing is much worse — and ask the consultant to come now.

response.zh-CN: 上级医生正在赶来。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The consultant is on the way. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 床旁监护：心率、呼吸、血氧饱和度和血压
name.en: Bedside monitoring of heart rate, breathing, oxygen saturation and blood pressure

dose.zh-CN: 床旁监护仪持续监测心率、呼吸、经皮血氧饱和度和血压，设置早产儿报警限。
dose.en: Continuous heart rate, breathing, oxygen saturation and blood pressure on the bedside monitor, with preterm alarm limits.

response.zh-CN: 监护已接上。本病例没有记录她的心率、呼吸频率、血氧饱和度或血压数值，也不模拟这些数值。
response.en: Monitoring on. This case records no heart rate, breathing rate, oxygen saturation or blood pressure values and does not simulate them.

name.zh-CN: 新建外周静脉通路
name.en: Place a new peripheral IV cannula

dose.zh-CN: 在另一侧肢体置入新生儿外周静脉留置针，用于补液、葡萄糖和药物；置管时同时抽血送检。
dose.en: A neonatal peripheral cannula in another limb for fluids, glucose and drugs; take bloods for the lab at the same time.

response.zh-CN: 外周静脉通路已建立，血标本已送检。本病例没有记录停用PICC后用的是哪种静脉通路；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Peripheral access in place and bloods sent. This case does not record what access was used once the PICC was out of use; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 取血培养后经验性静脉抗生素（晚发型感染方案）
name.en: Empirical IV antibiotics after the blood culture (late-onset regimen)

dose.zh-CN: 先取血培养，在决定治疗后 1 小时内开始；已在新生儿病房的晚发型感染，NICE NG195（2021）首选窄谱联合方案（如氟氯西林加庆大霉素），带中心静脉导管时按当地方案调整；剂量按体重计算；48 小时培养阴性且起初怀疑不强时考虑停药。
dose.en: Blood culture first, then start within 1 hour of the decision; for late-onset infection in a baby already in a neonatal unit NICE NG195 (2021) advises a narrow-spectrum combination such as flucloxacillin plus gentamicin, adapted to local policy for babies with central lines; doses by weight; consider stopping at 48 hours if the culture is negative and the initial suspicion was low.

harm.zh-CN: 先用抗生素、后取血培养会降低培养的阳性率：NICE NG195（2021）要求在第一剂抗生素前取血培养，并在决定治疗后 1 小时内给药。
harm.en: Antibiotics before the blood culture lower its yield: NICE NG195 (2021) asks for a blood culture before the first dose, with antibiotics within 1 hour of the decision to treat.

response.zh-CN: 已在取血培养后开始。本病例没有记录是否用过抗生素；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Started after the blood culture. This case does not record whether antibiotics were given; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 胸腔穿刺（超声引导）

dose.zh-CN: 先查血小板和凝血（危及生命时不因此拖延），超声定位并引导，细针抽吸影响呼吸的一侧；抽液量按体重（mL/kg）和她的反应决定并记录；抽出的液体送细胞计数和分类、甘油三酯和胆固醇、蛋白和乳酸脱氢酶、葡萄糖（同时测血糖）及培养。
dose.en: Check platelets and clotting first (never delaying a life-saving tap for them); locate and guide with ultrasound and aspirate the side compromising her breathing with a fine needle; judge and record the volume in mL/kg and by her response; send the fluid for cell count and differential, triglyceride and cholesterol, protein and LDH, glucose (with a paired blood glucose) and culture.

harm.zh-CN: 影像结果出来之前穿刺是盲穿：没有胸片或超声显示积液的位置和多少，针可能刺伤肺、心脏、肝或脾，也可能根本抽不到液体。先看影像，再在超声引导下穿刺。
harm.en: A tap before any imaging is blind: without a film or ultrasound showing where the fluid lies and how much there is, the needle can injure lung, heart, liver or spleen, or find nothing. Read the imaging first, then tap under ultrasound.

response.zh-CN: 已在超声引导下穿刺抽液，液体已送检，结果在下一阶段回报。报告记录的是胸腔穿刺抽液，每次 20–30 mL；穿刺次数、侧别和总量没有记录。
response.en: Tap done under ultrasound and the fluid sent; the results come back at the next stage. The report records pleural taps of 20–30 mL each; the number of taps, the sides and the total are not recorded.

name.zh-CN: 拔除PICC（核对拔出长度和尖端完整性）
name.en: Remove the PICC (check the length withdrawn and that the tip is intact)

dose.zh-CN: 停止输注后拔除；测量拔出的长度并与置管记录核对，检查尖端是否完整；怀疑感染时送尖端培养。
dose.en: Remove it once infusions have stopped; measure the length withdrawn against the insertion record and check that the tip is intact; send the tip for culture if infection is suspected.

response.zh-CN: PICC已拔除。报告记录拔除了PICC；拔出的长度、尖端情况和拔管时间没有记录。
response.en: PICC removed. The report records that the PICC was removed; the length withdrawn, the state of the tip and the timing are not recorded.

name.zh-CN: 向家属说明病情和计划，并上报不良事件
name.en: Explain what is happening and the plan to the family, and report the event

dose.zh-CN: 用通俗的话说明她为什么变差、可能与导管有关以及还不确定的地方、已经做了什么和接下来的计划；按医院流程上报导管相关不良事件。
dose.en: In plain words: why she got worse, that the line is the likely reason and what is still uncertain, what has been done and what comes next; report the line-related event through the hospital's system.

response.zh-CN: 已向家属说明并上报。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Family updated and the event reported. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 经PICC的输注照常进行，等影像回来再说
name.en: Keep the PICC infusions running as they are until the imaging is back

dose.zh-CN: 经PICC的输液泵保持原速度。
dose.en: Leave the pumps on the PICC at their current rates.

harm.zh-CN: 危险：带中心静脉导管的新生儿恶化，要首先想到导管相关的外渗和心包压塞（BAPM 2018）。如果液体正从导管渗入胸腔或心包，继续输注会让积液越来越多，甚至引起压塞；怀疑导管有问题时应停止经该导管输注、改用其他通路（INS 2024）。
harm.en: Dangerous: a deterioration in a newborn with a central line raises extravasation and tamponade first (BAPM 2018). If fluid is leaking from the line into the chest or pericardium, carrying on adds to the collection and can cause tamponade; when the line is suspect, stop infusing through it and use other access (INS 2024).

response.zh-CN: 输注继续进行。本病例没有记录当时经PICC输注的是什么；不模拟其后果。
response.en: The infusions carry on. This case does not record what was running through the PICC; it does not simulate the consequences.

name.zh-CN: 用力冲洗PICC，确认导管是否通畅
name.en: Flush the PICC hard to check that it is patent

dose.zh-CN: 用小注射器向PICC快速推注生理盐水。
dose.en: Push saline quickly into the PICC from a small syringe.

harm.zh-CN: 危险：怀疑导管渗漏或位置异常时用力冲管，会把更多液体推出血管；细小的导管在高压下还可能破裂。位置未明前不要使用这根导管，先用影像查清（INS 2024；BAPM 2018）。
harm.en: Dangerous: flushing hard when a leak or a malposition is suspected pushes more fluid out of the vessel, and a fine catheter can rupture under high pressure. Do not use the line until imaging has shown where it is (INS 2024; BAPM 2018).

response.zh-CN: 已冲管。本病例没有记录这一步；不模拟其后果。
response.en: Flushed. This case does not record this step; it does not simulate the consequences.

name.zh-CN: 把PICC在敷料下再往里送 1 cm
name.en: Advance the PICC 1 cm further under the dressing

dose.zh-CN: 揭开敷料，把导管外露部分再送入 1 cm 后重新固定。
dose.en: Lift the dressing, feed 1 cm of the external catheter back in and re-secure it.

harm.zh-CN: 危险：已在无菌区外的导管段不能再送回血管——会把皮肤细菌带进去；盲目推进还可能使尖端进入心脏或穿破血管。尖端应位于中心静脉、心影之外（BAPM 2018）；位置不理想时用影像评估，必要时重新置管。
harm.en: Dangerous: catheter that has lain outside the sterile field must not go back into the vein — it carries skin organisms in — and blind advancement can put the tip in the heart or through the vessel wall. The tip belongs in a central vein outside the cardiac silhouette (BAPM 2018); a poor position is assessed on imaging and, if need be, the line is re-sited.

response.zh-CN: 导管已推进。本病例没有记录这一步；不模拟其后果。
response.en: Catheter advanced. This case does not record this step; it does not simulate the consequences.

name.zh-CN: 再给一剂肺表面活性物质

dose.zh-CN: 经气管内给予一剂肺表面活性物质（按体重计算剂量）。
dose.en: One dose of surfactant into the trachea (dose by weight).

response.zh-CN: 已给药。本病例没有记录这次加用，也不模拟其效果。生后一周、带中心静脉导管时出现的新恶化，在排除导管并发症、气胸和感染之前，不能当作表面活性物质缺乏来处理。
response.en: Given. This case does not record such a dose and does not simulate its effect. A new deterioration a week after birth in a baby with a central line is not treated as surfactant deficiency until line complications, a pneumothorax and infection have been excluded.

name.zh-CN: 静脉注射呋塞米并限制液量

dose.zh-CN: 呋塞米按体重静脉注射，同时减少每日液量。
dose.en: Furosemide IV by weight, with a reduced daily fluid volume.

response.zh-CN: 已给药。本病例没有记录使用利尿剂，也不模拟其效果。利尿和限液清除不了已经漏进胸腔的液体，也代替不了停用可疑导管和引流。
response.en: Given. This case does not record a diuretic and does not simulate its effect. Diuresis and fluid restriction neither remove fluid that has leaked into the chest nor replace stopping the suspect line and draining.

title.en: Hear her story from her relative

hint.zh-CN: 她自己说不了：她多少周、多重出生？妈妈怀孕时出了什么问题？她身上有哪些管路，用过哪些治疗？这次是从哪天开始变差的？
hint.en: She cannot tell you herself: how early and how small was she at birth, what went wrong in the pregnancy, which lines and treatments has she had, and on which day did this start?

guidance.zh-CN: 到床旁向家属了解病史。
guidance.en: Go to her cot and take the history from her relative.

title.zh-CN: 床旁查看她，并翻阅早期记录
title.en: Look at her at the cot side and read her early notes

hint.zh-CN: 她的颜色、呼吸和反应说明情况有多急？病历里关于出生、治疗和那根导管写了什么？
hint.en: How urgent do her colour, breathing and responsiveness make this, and what do her notes say about her birth, her treatment and that line?

guidance.zh-CN: 在床旁查看她的肤色、呼吸费力程度和反应，并调阅早期病程记录和PICC置管记录。
guidance.en: At the cot side look at her colour, work of breathing and responsiveness, and read the early-course notes and the PICC insertion record.

hint.zh-CN: 她身上带着哪些管路？一个带着这些管路的早产儿明显变差，哪些原因最危险，哪些又能最快在床旁查清？
hint.en: Which lines does she have? In a preterm baby with those lines who is suddenly much worse, which causes are the most dangerous — and which can you check fastest at the cot side?

guidance.zh-CN: 在会诊板作答决策 1，并在床旁落实它的第一步处理。
guidance.en: Answer decision 1 on the case board and carry out its first steps at the cot side.

title.en: Read the imaging and act on it

hint.zh-CN: 这些影像能解释她的恶化吗？如果要穿刺，你希望抽出的液体回答哪些问题？那根导管还该不该留着用？
hint.en: Do the images explain her deterioration? If you tap, which questions should the fluid answer — and should that line stay in use?

guidance.zh-CN: 调阅床旁胸片和超声报告，作答决策 2，并在床旁落实方案。
guidance.en: Read the bedside film and ultrasound reports, answer decision 2 and put its plan into action at the cot side.

title.zh-CN: 解读新结果，安排她的恢复
title.en: Interpret the new results and plan her recovery

hint.zh-CN: 这份液体的外观和两项简易试验能说明什么、不能说明什么？要确定它从哪里来，还缺哪些指标？接下来她的营养、通路和随访怎么安排，又怎样告诉家属？
hint.en: What can the fluid's appearance and the two simple tests show, and what can they not? Which measurements would settle where it came from — and how will you plan her nutrition, access and follow-up, and tell her family?

guidance.zh-CN: 调阅穿刺液的各项结果，作答决策 3 和决策 4，并向家属说明。
guidance.en: Read the aspirate results, answer decisions 3 and 4, and talk to her family.

title.zh-CN: 回看报告记录的病程与结局
title.en: Look back at the reported course and outcome

hint.zh-CN: 决策都完成后，报告记录的处理和随访会开放：报告做了什么、她恢复得怎样？她的好转能证明是哪一步起了作用吗？
hint.en: Once the decisions are made, the report's treatment and follow-up open: what was done, how did she do — and does her recovery show which step worked?

guidance.zh-CN: 在护士站调阅报告记录的病程与结局。
guidance.en: Read the reported course and outcome at the nurses' station.

prompt.zh-CN: 7日龄女婴，孕 33+3 周剖宫产，出生体重 1.1 kg；用过呼吸支持、肺表面活性物质和静脉营养。生后第 2 天经右侧贵要静脉置入PICC，定位片示尖端在第 3 胸椎下缘。今天（置管第 5 天）呼吸明显加重：发绀，三凹征明显，反应极差。你首先怎么做？
prompt.en: A 7-day-old girl born by caesarean at 33+3 weeks (birth weight 1.1 kg) has had respiratory support, surfactant and parenteral nutrition. A PICC went in through the right basilic vein on day 2, its tip at the lower border of T3 on the position film. Today (catheter day 5) her breathing is much worse: she is cyanosed, with marked recession and very poor responsiveness. What do you do first?

need.zh-CN: 先查看她的肤色、呼吸费力程度和反应，向家属问清出生情况和这次从哪天开始变差，并调阅早期病程记录和PICC置管记录。
need.en: First look at her colour, work of breathing and responsiveness, ask her relative about her birth and when this began, and read the early-course notes and the PICC insertion record.

text.zh-CN: 支持呼吸并呼叫上级；立即停止经PICC的全部输注（不冲管、不推送导管）；急查床旁胸片和超声心动图；取血培养后经新建的外周静脉给经验性抗生素。
text.en: Support her breathing and call senior help; stop everything running through the PICC without flushing it or pushing it in; get an urgent bedside chest film and echocardiogram; take a blood culture and give empirical antibiotics through new peripheral access.

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。BAPM《新生儿中心静脉导管使用框架》（2015年发布、2018年修订）提出，带中心静脉导管的新生儿出现任何恶化，都要想到导管相关并发症，尤其是感染、外渗和心包压塞。先停止经该导管输注、不冲管，再用床旁胸片和超声心动图查清心包、胸腔和导管位置；感染同时处理：先取血培养，在决定治疗后1小时内用抗生素（NICE NG195，2021）。
feedback.en: Right. The BAPM framework on central venous catheters in neonates (2015, revised 2018) says any deterioration in a baby with a central line should raise catheter complications — infection, extravasation and tamponade above all. Stop infusing through the line without flushing it, then let a bedside film and echocardiogram show the pericardium, the pleura and the tip; treat possible infection alongside, with a blood culture first and antibiotics within 1 hour of the decision (NICE NG195, 2021).

text.zh-CN: 按呼吸窘迫综合征加重处理：提高呼吸支持的压力和吸入氧浓度，再给一剂肺表面活性物质；输液照常进行，避免低血糖；胸片安排在明早查房前拍，和血气一起看。
text.en: Treat it as worsening respiratory distress syndrome: raise the pressure and oxygen of her support and give another dose of surfactant; keep the infusions running so she does not become hypoglycaemic; get a chest film before the morning round and read it with a blood gas.

feedback.zh-CN: 生后一周、置管第 5 天出现的新恶化，在排除导管并发症、气胸和感染之前，不能当作表面活性物质缺乏来处理（BAPM 2018把导管相关的外渗、压塞和感染放在首位）。让可能外渗的液体继续输入、把胸片拖到第二天，都会延误发现心包或胸腔积液。
feedback.en: A new deterioration a week after birth, on catheter day 5, is not treated as surfactant deficiency until line complications, a pneumothorax and infection are excluded — BAPM (2018) puts catheter extravasation, tamponade and infection first. Keeping a possibly leaking infusion running and leaving the film until the morning both delay finding fluid around the heart or lungs.

text.zh-CN: 按晚发型败血症处理：取血培养后马上经PICC推注抗生素，因为它是她最可靠的静脉通路；静脉营养不停，以免低血糖；影像先不做，看抗生素治疗 24 小时后的反应再定。
text.en: Treat it as late-onset sepsis: take a blood culture and give antibiotics straight through the PICC, her most reliable access; keep the parenteral nutrition going to avoid hypoglycaemia; hold off imaging and judge her response to 24 hours of antibiotics.

feedback.zh-CN: 感染确实要考虑，取血培养后1小时内用抗生素也是对的（NICE NG195，2021）；错在继续使用可疑的导管：如果液体正从导管渗到胸腔或心包，再推药、再输营养只会加重积液。怀疑导管有问题时应停止经其输注、改用其他通路（INS输液治疗实践标准，2024），并立即做影像检查。
feedback.en: Infection does belong in the picture, and antibiotics within 1 hour after a blood culture are right (NICE NG195, 2021); the error is using the suspect line. If fluid is leaking from it into the chest or pericardium, more drugs and nutrition through it add to the collection: stop infusing through a suspect line, use other access (INS Infusion Therapy Standards, 2024) and image her now.

text.zh-CN: 按张力性气胸处理：不等任何影像，立即在两侧锁骨中线第 2 肋间各穿刺减压一次；她好转后再拍胸片确认，PICC和输液照常使用，不必因此停用。
text.en: Treat it as a tension pneumothorax: needle both sides in the second intercostal space, midclavicular line, at once without waiting for imaging; confirm with a film once she improves, and keep using the PICC and its infusions meanwhile.

feedback.zh-CN: 张力性气胸在鉴别之列，但只有濒危、来不及做透光试验或床旁超声时才盲穿减压；两侧同时盲穿可能刺伤肺组织，还会漏掉心包压塞和胸腔积液。带中心静脉导管的新生儿恶化，应先停用导管输注并尽快做影像（BAPM 2018）。
feedback.en: A tension pneumothorax is on the list, but blind needling is for a baby in extremis with no time for transillumination or a bedside ultrasound; needling both sides at once can injure the lungs and still misses tamponade and pleural fluid. In a newborn with a central line, stop infusing through the line and image her first (BAPM 2018).

prompt.zh-CN: 床旁影像：双侧胸腔积液伴肺不张；超声示右侧积液更多，另有少量腹水。之后的胸片描述PICC尖端位置同前（第 3 胸椎下缘）。超声心动图没有结果记录。下一步怎么做？
prompt.en: Bedside imaging: bilateral pleural effusions with atelectasis; on ultrasound, more fluid on the right and a small amount of ascites. Later films described the PICC tip as unchanged (lower border of T3). No echocardiogram result is recorded. What do you do next?

need.zh-CN: 先完成决策 1，并调阅床旁胸片、超声和超声心动图的结果。
need.en: Answer decision 1, then read the bedside film, ultrasound and echocardiogram results.

text.zh-CN: 按导管相关积液处理：停用并拔除PICC；查血小板和凝血后，超声引导下穿刺影响呼吸的一侧，液体送细胞计数和分类、甘油三酯、蛋白、葡萄糖（对照血糖）和培养；改经外周静脉补液，并复查超声。
text.en: Treat it as a line-related effusion: stop using the PICC and remove it; check platelets and clotting, then tap the side compromising her breathing under ultrasound for cell count and differential, triglyceride, protein, glucose (paired with blood) and culture; give fluids peripherally and rescan.

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。置管后出现双侧积液伴腹水，在找到其他原因之前按导管相关处理：不再经可疑导管输注、改用其他通路（INS 2024），影响呼吸的积液在超声引导下穿刺。血小板和凝血情况没有记录，穿刺前要先查，危及生命时不因此拖延。液体要能回答它是什么：细胞分类和甘油三酯对照儿童乳糜标准（Büttiker 1999），葡萄糖与血糖对照可提示输注液外渗；拔管后营养可短期经外周静脉给予（NICE NG154，2020）。
feedback.en: Right. Effusions on both sides with ascites after a line went in are treated as line-related until shown otherwise: no more infusion through the suspect line, other access instead (INS 2024), and an ultrasound-guided tap of an effusion that compromises breathing. Her platelets and clotting are not recorded, so check them first without letting them delay a life-saving tap. The fluid must say what it is — cell differential and triglyceride against the paediatric chyle criteria (Büttiker 1999), glucose against the blood for leaked infusate — and after removal nutrition can go peripherally for a short time (NICE NG154, 2020).

text.zh-CN: 考虑与导管无关的先天性乳糜胸：PICC继续用于静脉营养，改喂中链甘油三酯配方奶并开始奥曲肽；积液先不穿刺，一周后复查超声，增多了再引流，免得反复穿刺给这么小的孩子增加感染和气胸的风险。
text.en: Consider a congenital chylothorax unrelated to the line: keep the PICC for parenteral nutrition, switch her to a medium-chain triglyceride formula and start octreotide; leave the effusions untapped and rescan in a week, draining only if they grow, to spare so small a baby the infection and pneumothorax risk of repeated needling.

feedback.zh-CN: 先天性乳糜胸通常在出生前后就表现出来；置管第 5 天才出现的双侧积液伴腹水，应先按导管相关处理，而不是继续经这根导管输注。中链甘油三酯喂养和奥曲肽只用于确诊且持续的乳糜漏，Cochrane系统评价（2010）没有找到奥曲肽的随机对照试验，无法据此作出推荐。
feedback.en: A congenital chylothorax usually shows itself before or around birth; effusions on both sides with ascites appearing on catheter day 5 are treated as line-related first, not by carrying on infusing through that line. MCT feeding and octreotide are for a confirmed, persistent chyle leak, and the Cochrane review (2010) found no randomised trials of octreotide on which to base a recommendation.

text.zh-CN: 考虑动脉导管未闭或液体过多引起的心力衰竭：限制液量、静推呋塞米，PICC和静脉营养照常使用；24 小时后复查胸片，积液不减再考虑穿刺，同时安排心脏专科会诊评估动脉导管。
text.en: Consider heart failure from a patent ductus or fluid overload: restrict fluids and give IV furosemide, carry on with the PICC and parenteral nutrition, repeat the film in 24 hours and tap only if the effusions persist, with a cardiology opinion on the duct.

feedback.zh-CN: 超声心动图没有结果记录，动脉导管未闭和心力衰竭都没有依据；限液和利尿清除不了已经漏进胸腔的输注液，而继续经可疑导管输注只会让积液更多。BAPM（2018）要求先考虑导管并发症，影响呼吸的积液应当引流。
feedback.en: No echocardiogram result is recorded, so neither a patent ductus nor heart failure is shown; fluid restriction and diuretics do not remove infusate that has leaked into the chest, and infusing through the suspect line keeps adding to it. BAPM (2018) puts catheter complications first, and an effusion that compromises breathing is drained.

text.zh-CN: 尖端在第 3 胸椎下缘偏高，问题出在位置：在敷料下把导管再送入 1 cm 到第 5 胸椎水平，拍片确认后继续经它输注静脉营养；积液量不大时先观察，不急于穿刺，以免刺伤肺。
text.en: The tip at the lower border of T3 sits too high, so position is the problem: advance the catheter 1 cm under the dressing to T5, confirm on a film and continue the nutrition through it; if the effusions are small, watch rather than tap so as not to injure the lung.

feedback.zh-CN: 椎体平面只是尖端位置的近似，各指南给出的标志并不一致；真正的要求是尖端在中心静脉、位于心脏之外（BAPM 2018；ESPGHAN/ESPEN/ESPR/CSPEN 2018）。把已经在无菌区外的导管段再送进去，会把皮肤细菌带入血管，还可能把尖端顶进心脏；而且这样既没有处理积液，也没有停用可疑的导管。
feedback.en: A vertebral level only approximates the tip position, and guidelines quote different landmarks; what matters is a central tip outside the heart (BAPM 2018; ESPGHAN/ESPEN/ESPR/CSPEN 2018). Pushing in catheter that has lain outside the sterile field carries skin organisms into the vein and can drive the tip into the heart — and it neither treats the effusions nor stops using the suspect line.

prompt.zh-CN: 穿刺液：淡黄色、透明，乙醚试验阳性，李凡他试验阴性，培养阴性。细胞计数和分类、甘油三酯、蛋白和葡萄糖都没有结果记录。团队把它称为乳糜胸。这份胸水能证明什么？
prompt.en: The aspirate: pale yellow and clear, ether test positive, Rivalta test negative, culture negative. No cell count or differential, triglyceride, protein or glucose result is recorded. The team calls it chylothorax. What does this fluid establish?

need.zh-CN: 先完成决策 2，并调阅穿刺液常规、培养、生化和细胞计数的结果。
need.en: Answer decision 2, then read the aspirate's routine analysis, culture, chemistry and cell count.

text.zh-CN: 它提示液体里可能有脂肪、蛋白不高、培养阴性，但区分不了乳糜和漏出的静脉营养液；乳糜胸还缺细胞分类和甘油三酯（且要在有脂肪摄入时判断），液体葡萄糖也没有和血糖对照。
text.en: It suggests fat in a low-protein, culture-negative fluid but cannot tell chyle from leaked parenteral nutrition; calling it chylothorax still needs the cell differential and triglyceride (read with fat intake), and its glucose was never compared with the blood.

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。按Büttiker等（1999）的儿童标准，乳糜需要有经口脂肪摄入时甘油三酯 > 1.1 mmol/L，且细胞数 ≥ 1000/µL、淋巴细胞 > 80 %，这些都没有结果记录。乙醚试验只提示有脂肪，漏出的脂肪乳也会阳性；没有喂含脂肪的奶时乳糜可以清亮；液体葡萄糖远高于血糖、细胞又少，更支持输注液外渗。
feedback.en: Right. The paediatric criteria of Büttiker and colleagues (1999) call fluid chyle at a triglyceride > 1.1 mmol/L with oral fat intake and ≥ 1000 cells/µL with > 80 % lymphocytes, and none of these is recorded here. An ether test shows only that fat is present, which leaked lipid emulsion also gives; chyle can look clear without fat feeds; and a fluid glucose far above the blood glucose with few cells would favour leaked infusate.

text.zh-CN: 乙醚试验阳性说明液体里有乳糜微粒，乳糜胸已经确诊：应停喂普通奶、改用中链甘油三酯配方，同时开始奥曲肽减少淋巴液生成，并尽快请小儿外科评估胸导管，必要时做胸膜固定术。
text.en: A positive ether test shows chylomicrons, so chylothorax is confirmed: stop ordinary milk, switch to a medium-chain triglyceride formula, start octreotide to cut lymph flow and ask the paediatric surgeons to assess the thoracic duct soon, with pleurodesis if needed.

feedback.zh-CN: 乳糜胸是报告当年的诊断，但这里记录的证据不够：乙醚试验只能提示脂肪，证明不了乳糜微粒，漏出的脂肪乳同样阳性；按儿童标准（Büttiker 1999）还缺甘油三酯和细胞分类。奥曲肽只用于确诊且持续的乳糜漏，Cochrane系统评价（2010）没有找到随机对照试验，无法据此作出推荐。
feedback.en: Chylothorax was the report's label, but the evidence recorded here falls short: an ether test shows fat, not chylomicrons, and leaked lipid emulsion is positive too, while the paediatric criteria (Büttiker 1999) still need a triglyceride and a cell differential. Octreotide is for a confirmed, persistent chyle leak, and the Cochrane review (2010) found no randomised trials to base a recommendation on.

text.zh-CN: 液体清亮、不是乳白色，可以排除乳糜；李凡他试验阴性说明是漏出液，原因是液体过多，限液加利尿即可，用不着再做甘油三酯和细胞学检查，也不必再穿刺。
text.en: The fluid is clear, not milky, so chyle is excluded; a negative Rivalta test means a transudate from fluid overload, treated with fluid restriction and a diuretic, with no need for a triglyceride, cell count or further taps.

feedback.zh-CN: 清亮排除不了乳糜：没有喂含脂肪的奶时，乳糜可以是清亮的，Büttiker等（1999）的甘油三酯标准也以有经口脂肪摄入为前提。李凡他试验是粗略的定性试验，阴性只提示蛋白不高，不能说明原因是液体过多；漏出的静脉营养液蛋白同样很低。
feedback.en: Clear fluid does not exclude chyle: without fat feeds chyle can be clear, and the triglyceride criterion of Büttiker and colleagues (1999) assumes oral fat intake. The Rivalta test is a crude qualitative test; a negative result suggests little protein, not fluid overload — leaked parenteral nutrition is low in protein as well.

text.zh-CN: 导管穿破了胸导管：它从右臂进入，走行紧贴胸导管，漏出的是乳糜，属于直接损伤，应尽快请小儿外科评估胸导管结扎，期间禁食并给予全量静脉营养。
text.en: The catheter has perforated the thoracic duct: entering from the right arm it runs right beside the duct, so this is chyle from a direct injury, and a paediatric surgeon should assess her for duct ligation soon, with nil by mouth and full parenteral nutrition meanwhile.

feedback.zh-CN: 解剖上不成立：经右侧贵要静脉的导管走行于右锁骨下静脉、右头臂静脉到上腔静脉，而胸导管汇入左侧静脉角，这根导管不会经过胸导管的开口。双侧积液伴腹水更符合中心性的原因（输注液外渗，或中心静脉回流受阻影响淋巴回流）；而且是不是乳糜，本身还要先按儿童标准确定（Büttiker 1999）。
feedback.en: Anatomically it does not hold: a line from the right basilic vein runs through the right subclavian and right brachiocephalic veins to the superior vena cava, while the thoracic duct drains into the left venous angle, so this catheter never passes the duct's opening. Bilateral effusions with ascites fit a central cause better (leaked infusate, or obstructed central venous return holding back lymph), and whether this is chyle at all must first be settled by the paediatric criteria (Büttiker 1999).

prompt.zh-CN: PICC已拔除，胸腔已经穿刺。她的喂养情况没有记录。接下来她的营养、通路、复查和随访怎么安排？
prompt.en: The PICC is out and the chest has been tapped. Her feeding is not recorded. How will you plan her nutrition, access, rescans and follow-up from here?

need.zh-CN: 先完成决策 3，并拔除PICC、完成胸腔穿刺。
need.en: Answer decision 3, and have the PICC removed and the chest tapped first.

text.zh-CN: 用床旁超声复查积液是否再长；营养暂经外周静脉给予，确需再置中心静脉时用影像确认尖端在中心静脉、心脏之外并记录肢体位置；乳糜饮食和奥曲肽留给确诊且持续的乳糜漏；上报不良事件，如实告诉家属，安排生长发育随访。
text.en: Rescan for reaccumulation; give nutrition peripherally for now and, if a central line is truly needed again, confirm on imaging a central tip outside the heart with the limb position recorded; keep chyle diets and octreotide for a confirmed, persistent leak; report the event, tell the family honestly and arrange growth and development follow-up.

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。中心静脉导管必须拔除时，短期经外周静脉给予营养是NICE NG154（2020）认可的做法；再置中心静脉时，尖端应位于心影之外（BAPM 2018），用影像确认并记录肢体位置。乳糜饮食只在乳糜确诊且持续时才有依据（Büttiker 1999以无脂喂养为第一步），奥曲肽缺乏随机对照试验（Cochrane 2010）；如实说明并发症及其不确定性，是家属信任的基础。
feedback.en: Right. Short-term peripheral nutrition when a central line has to come out is what NICE NG154 (2020) allows; a new central line needs a tip outside the cardiac silhouette (BAPM 2018), confirmed on imaging with the limb position recorded. Chyle diets have a basis only for a confirmed, persistent leak (fat-free feeding came first in Büttiker 1999) and octreotide lacks randomised trials (Cochrane 2010); an honest account of the complication and its uncertainty is what keeps the family's trust.

text.zh-CN: 积液已经抽出，趁血管条件还好，今天就从同一侧贵要静脉重新置入PICC，送到与上次相同的长度并恢复全量静脉营养；尖端位置以上次的定位片为准，这样可以少拍一张片子。
text.en: Now that the fluid is out and her veins are still good, re-site a PICC through the same basilic vein today to the same length as before and restart full parenteral nutrition, taking the old position film as proof of the tip so as to spare her another X-ray.

feedback.zh-CN: 旧片证明不了新导管的位置：每次置管都要用影像确认尖端在中心静脉、位于心影之外（BAPM 2018），并记录肢体位置，因为尖端会随肢体活动而移动。积液的原因（包括静脉血栓）还没有查清，不宜马上按同一路径、同一长度再置管；短期可经外周静脉给营养（NICE NG154，2020）。
feedback.en: An old film proves nothing about a new line: every placement needs imaging that confirms a central tip outside the cardiac silhouette (BAPM 2018) with the limb position recorded, because tips move with the limb. With the cause of the effusions — thrombosis included — not yet established, re-siting by the same route to the same length at once is unwise; short-term peripheral nutrition is an option (NICE NG154, 2020).

text.zh-CN: 既然团队诊断为乳糜胸，就按乳糜胸处理两周：停喂普通奶，改用中链甘油三酯配方，持续静脉输注奥曲肽；不论积液是否再长都按疗程用完，以防复发，期间不必再复查超声。
text.en: Since the team diagnosed chylothorax, treat it as such for two weeks: no ordinary milk, a medium-chain triglyceride formula and a continuous octreotide infusion, completed whatever happens to the effusions to prevent a relapse, with no need for rescans meanwhile.

feedback.zh-CN: 乳糜胸并未确诊（见决策 3），按标签而不是证据用药只会增加风险：奥曲肽在新生儿不是有确立证据的治疗，Cochrane系统评价（2010）没有找到随机对照试验；中链甘油三酯配方只适用于确诊且持续的乳糜漏。用超声随访积液，按结果决定下一步。
feedback.en: Chylothorax is not established (decision 3), and treating the label rather than the evidence only adds risk: octreotide is not an established treatment in newborns and the Cochrane review (2010) found no randomised trials, while an MCT formula is for a confirmed, persistent chyle leak. Follow the effusions with ultrasound and decide on the results.

text.zh-CN: 她已经在好转：停止超声复查；原因并未证实，不必上报不良事件；对家属只说这是早产儿常见的问题，以免增加他们的焦虑；出院后按常规体检，不另做生长发育随访。
text.en: She is improving: stop the rescans; the cause is unproven, so no incident report; tell the family only that this is a common problem in premature babies, to avoid adding to their anxiety; routine checks after discharge, with no separate growth and development follow-up.

feedback.zh-CN: 好转代替不了随访：积液可能再长，需要超声复查；导管相关的严重事件应当上报，以便病区改进置管和维护（BAPM 2018把外渗列为每个带管新生儿都要警惕的并发症）。把导管并发症说成“早产常见问题”不是如实告知，家属有权知道发生了什么、还有哪些不确定。
feedback.en: Improvement does not replace follow-up: effusions can reaccumulate and need rescanning, and a serious line-related event is reported so the unit can learn from it (BAPM 2018 lists extravasation among the complications to watch for in every baby with a line). Calling a line complication “a common problem in premature babies” is not honest disclosure; the family has a right to know what happened and what remains uncertain.

text.zh-CN: 向家属问清出生胎龄和体重、母亲孕期情况、手臂上的导管、用过的呼吸支持和营养，以及这次从哪天开始加重；并问到喂奶和那只胳膊
text.en: Asked the relative about gestation and birth weight, the pregnancy, the line in her arm, her breathing support and nutrition and the day this began, and about milk feeds and that arm

text.zh-CN: 在床旁查看她的肤色、呼吸费力程度和反应
text.en: Examined her colour, work of breathing and responsiveness at the cot side

text.zh-CN: 先调阅早期病程记录和PICC置管记录，再读床旁胸片、超声和穿刺液常规的结果
text.en: Read the early-course notes and the PICC insertion record, then the bedside film, the ultrasound and the aspirate's routine analysis

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择以导管为先的床旁处理（决策 1）
text.en: Chose the line-first bedside response at the first attempt (decision 1)

text.zh-CN: 任何影像结果出来之前：停止经PICC的输注（或已拔除），并在恶化阶段申请床旁胸片和超声心动图
text.en: Before any imaging result: stopped infusing through the PICC (or removed it) and requested a bedside chest film and an echocardiogram during the deterioration

text.zh-CN: 升级呼吸支持、接上监护并呼叫上级；先取血培养，再经新建的外周静脉给经验性抗生素
text.en: Escalated support, started monitoring and called senior help; took a blood culture, then gave empirical antibiotics through new peripheral access

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即把积液按导管相关处理，并定下引流、送检和换用通路的方案（决策 2）
text.en: Treated the effusions as line-related, with a plan for drainage, fluid tests and new access, at the first attempt (decision 2)

text.zh-CN: 完成超声引导下胸腔穿刺并拔除PICC
text.en: Tapped the chest under ultrasound guidance and removed the PICC

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即看出这份胸水分不清乳糜和外渗的输注液（决策 3）
text.en: Saw at the first attempt that this fluid cannot separate chyle from leaked infusate (decision 3)

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即给出复查、通路、营养、上报和随访的安全计划（决策 4）
text.en: Gave a safe plan for rescans, access, nutrition, reporting and follow-up at the first attempt (decision 4)

text.zh-CN: 没有继续经可疑的PICC输注、没有用力冲管，也没有把导管往里推送
text.en: Did not keep infusing through the suspect PICC, flush it hard or push it further in

text.zh-CN: 向家属如实说明她为什么变差、可能的导管并发症和接下来的计划，并核实理解
text.en: Explained honestly to the family why she got worse, the probable line complication and the plan, and checked understanding

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 按Calgary–Cambridge结构，与一个7日龄早产儿的家属谈话：先了解他们已经知道什么、最怕什么（孩子挺不过去、是不是哪里做错了）；用通俗的话说明她变差是因为两侧胸腔和肚子里有了积液，手臂上那根细管子是最可能的原因，已经停用并拔除、积液已经抽出；如实说明还不知道这些液体是淋巴液还是漏出来的营养液，区分它们的化验正在做；承认这是并发症，不推诿、不指责，并说明会上报以便改进；不作“一定会好”之类的保证；讲清接下来的安排（呼吸支持、新的静脉通路、超声复查积液、营养、生长发育随访），用回授法确认家属听懂了，并留出提问的时间。
judgeGuidance.en: Calgary–Cambridge structure with the relative of a 7-day-old preterm baby: find out what they already know and fear most (that she will not pull through, that something was done wrong); explain in plain words that she got worse because fluid collected around both lungs and in her tummy, that the thin line in her arm is the most likely reason, and that it has been stopped and taken out and the fluid drained; be honest that it is not yet known whether the fluid is lymph or nutrition fluid that leaked, and that tests to tell them apart are being done; acknowledge the complication without defensiveness or blame and say it will be reported so the unit can learn; give no promise that all will be well; explain the plan (breathing support, a new drip, scans to watch the fluid, feeding, growth and development follow-up), check understanding by teach-back and leave room for questions.

name.zh-CN: 沈医生（新生儿科主治医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教，按PEARLS引导，只围绕学员已经拿到的资料提问。要引导出的推理：带中心静脉导管的早产儿明显变差，为什么先想导管（感染、液体外渗入胸腔或心包、心包压塞、血栓），哪一种最致命、哪项检查能在床旁最快排除；为什么怀疑导管时先停输注、不冲管、不推送导管；椎体平面为什么只是尖端位置的近似，目标是中心静脉、心脏之外，而且尖端会随肢体位置移动，“位置同前”说明了什么、没说明什么；穿刺抽出的液体要回答什么——乳糜还是外渗的输注液，各需要哪些指标；右侧贵要静脉导管的走行与左侧胸导管开口的关系；抽液量为什么要按mL/kg来想；拔管后营养和通路怎么安排；怎样如实向家属说明可能的导管并发症。历史与现行：复盘时再把报告当年的处理和诊断与BAPM 2018、INS 2024、Büttiker 1999和NICE NG154、NG195对照。病例没有记录的内容（生命体征、血气、呼吸支持的方式和参数、静脉营养的成分及经哪根导管输注、喂奶情况、当时体重、超声心动图、血管超声、穿刺液的细胞和生化、血培养）不要替它补上。学员作答前不说出病因、任何决策的正确选项或报告的处理与结局。
knowledge.en: A Socratic teacher using PEARLS who asks only about information the learner already has. Reasoning to draw out: why a preterm baby with a central line who is much worse raises the line first (infection, fluid leaking into the chest or pericardium, tamponade, thrombosis), which of these is most lethal and which bedside test excludes it fastest; why a suspect line is stopped, not flushed and not pushed in; why a vertebral level only approximates the tip, why the target is a central vein outside the heart, why tips move with the limb, and what “position unchanged” does and does not show; what the aspirated fluid must answer — chyle or leaked infusate — and which measurements decide it; how a right basilic line runs relative to the thoracic duct's left-sided opening; why a tap volume is thought of in mL/kg; how nutrition and access continue after the line is out; how to tell the family honestly about a probable line complication. Then and now: in the debrief, set the report's management and diagnosis against BAPM 2018, INS 2024, Büttiker 1999 and NICE NG154 and NG195. Never supply what the case does not record (vital signs, blood gases, the mode and settings of support, the nutrition's composition and which line it ran through, milk feeds, her current weight, an echocardiogram, a vein scan, the aspirate's cells and chemistry, a blood culture). Before the learner commits, never state the cause, any decision's correct option, or the report's management and outcome.

name.zh-CN: 许护士（新生儿监护室）

knowledge.zh-CN: 新生儿监护室护士。交班（ISBAR）：7日龄女婴，孕33+3周剖宫产，出生体重1.1 kg，母亲重度子痫前期；生后即有气促，用过呼吸支持、肺表面活性物质和静脉营养；生后第2天经右上肢置入PICC。今天呼吸明显加重：发绀，三凹征明显，反应极差；家属在床旁。病区有监护仪、呼吸机（也能做无创支持）、输液泵和暖箱；抢救车上有外周静脉置管用物、气道用物和急救药品；床旁胸片、超声和超声心动图可以在床旁做；病历和报告在护士站电脑上调阅。可以按医嘱停止经PICC的输注、协助穿刺、建立外周静脉通路。复述医嘱，只报告已经回报的结果，不解读、不诊断；被问到病例没有记录的内容（心率、呼吸、血氧饱和度、血压、体温、当前体重、经PICC输注的是什么、呼吸支持的参数、喂奶情况）时，如实说没有记录。
knowledge.en: Neonatal unit nurse. Handover (ISBAR): 7-day-old girl born by caesarean at 33+3 weeks, birth weight 1.1 kg, after severe maternal pre-eclampsia; breathless from birth and treated with respiratory support, surfactant and parenteral nutrition; a PICC went into her right arm on day 2. Today her breathing is much worse: cyanosed, with marked recession and very poor responsiveness; a relative is at the cot side. The unit has monitors, ventilators (which also give non-invasive support), infusion pumps and an incubator; the crash trolley holds cannulation kit, airway kit and emergency drugs; the chest film, ultrasound and echocardiogram can be done at the cot side; notes and reports are on the nurses' station computer. Can stop the infusions through the PICC on instruction, assist with a tap and place a peripheral cannula. Reads orders back and reports only results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses; asked about anything the case does not record (heart rate, breathing rate, oxygen saturation, blood pressure, temperature, current weight, what was running through the PICC, the support settings, milk feeds), says plainly that it is not recorded.

name.zh-CN: 高医生（放射科）

knowledge.zh-CN: 放射科医生，只解读学员已经调阅的影像和置管记录。可以讲：新生儿胸片和床旁超声怎样区分胸腔积液、肺不张和气胸；超声对少量积液和腹水更敏感，还能引导穿刺；胸片上用椎体平面描述PICC尖端只是近似，判断时要看尖端是否在上腔静脉、是否在心影之外，并注意拍片时上肢的位置会影响尖端位置；连续胸片“位置同前”只说明导管没有明显移位，不能排除血管壁损伤或静脉血栓；超声心动图可查心包积液，多普勒超声可查上肢和中心静脉血栓。不替病例补充积液深度或量、心包情况或任何没有记录的结果，不解读报告记录的结局。
knowledge.en: Radiologist who interprets only the images and line record the learner has already read. Can explain: how a neonatal chest film and a bedside ultrasound separate pleural fluid, atelectasis and a pneumothorax; that ultrasound is more sensitive to small effusions and ascites and can guide a tap; that a vertebral level only approximates a PICC tip on a film, so the questions are whether the tip lies in the superior vena cava and outside the cardiac silhouette, with the arm position on the film changing where it lies; that serial films reading “position unchanged” show only that the line has not visibly moved, not that the vessel wall is intact or the vein free of thrombus; that an echocardiogram looks for pericardial fluid and a Doppler scan for thrombus in the arm and central veins. Never supplies a fluid depth or volume, a pericardial finding or any unrecorded result, and never interprets the reported outcome.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：带PICC的早产儿呼吸恶化与双侧胸腔积液
title.en: Debrief: a preterm baby with a PICC whose breathing worsens with fluid around both lungs

conclusion.zh-CN: 孕 33+3 周因母亲重度子痫前期剖宫产的女婴，出生体重 1.1 kg，生后即气促，用过呼吸支持、肺表面活性物质和静脉营养；生后第 2 天经右侧贵要静脉置入PICC，尖端位于第 3 胸椎下缘。置管第 5 天（7日龄）出现发绀、三凹征明显、反应极差，呼吸支持升级。影像示双侧胸腔积液伴肺不张，右侧较多，并有少量腹水；之后的胸片描述尖端位置同前。胸水淡黄透明，乙醚试验阳性，李凡他试验阴性，培养阴性。经胸腔穿刺（每次 20–30 mL）并拔除PICC后，积液和腹水消退，转回CPAP；住院 54 天、体重 2.4 kg 出院，2 个月和 4 个月随访生长发育报告正常。报告诊断为PICC所致双侧乳糜胸并腹水，但已记录的检查分不清乳糜和外渗的输注液。现行做法：导管优先，停用导管并做超声心动图，超声引导下引流并完整送检，拔除导管、改用外周通路。
conclusion.en: A girl born by caesarean at 33+3 weeks for severe maternal pre-eclampsia (1.1 kg), breathless from birth, had respiratory support, surfactant and parenteral nutrition; a right basilic PICC went in on day 2, tip at the lower border of T3. On catheter day 5 (day 7 of life) she was cyanosed, with marked recession and very poor responsiveness, and support was escalated. Imaging showed bilateral pleural effusions with atelectasis, more on the right, and a little ascites; later films: tip unchanged. The fluid: pale yellow, clear, ether-positive, Rivalta-negative, culture-negative. After 20–30 mL taps and PICC removal the fluid resolved and she returned to CPAP; she went home after 54 days at 2.4 kg; growth and development were reported normal at 2 and 4 months. The report called it PICC-related bilateral chylothorax with ascites; the recorded tests cannot tell chyle from leaked infusate. Today: line first, echocardiography, ultrasound-guided drainage with full fluid tests, line removal.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 带中心静脉导管的早产儿在置管第 5 天明显恶化，首先要想到导管：液体漏入胸腔或心包、心包压塞、血栓和感染，同时考虑气胸；生后一周新出现的恶化，不能想当然地归为表面活性物质缺乏。
keyReasoning.en: A preterm baby with a central line who is much worse on catheter day 5 has the line at the top of the list — leakage into the chest or pericardium, tamponade, thrombosis, infection — beside a pneumothorax; a new turn for the worse a week after birth is not presumed to be surfactant deficiency.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 发绀、三凹征明显、反应极差说明情况紧急：支持呼吸、停用导管、查看心脏和胸腔这几步要在病因明确之前完成，而且无论最后是哪种原因都需要做。
keyReasoning.en: Cyanosis, marked recession and very poor responsiveness make this an emergency: supporting her breathing, stopping the line and looking at the heart and chest come before any cause is proven, and are needed whichever cause it turns out to be.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 置管后出现双侧胸腔积液伴腹水，提示中心性的原因——输注液外渗，或静脉、淋巴回流受阻——而不是局部撕裂；经右侧贵要静脉的导管到不了位于左侧的胸导管开口。
keyReasoning.en: Effusions on both sides with ascites after a line went in point to a central cause — leaked infusate, or obstructed venous or lymphatic drainage — rather than a focal tear; a right basilic line never reaches the thoracic duct's left-sided opening.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 清亮、乙醚试验阳性、李凡他试验阴性、培养阴性的胸水，只说明可能含脂肪、蛋白不高；在测出甘油三酯、细胞分类和葡萄糖之前，乳糜和漏出的营养液都说得通。
keyReasoning.en: A clear, ether-positive, Rivalta-negative, culture-negative fluid says that fat is probably present and protein low, and nothing more: chyle and leaked nutrition both fit until the triglyceride, the cell differential and the glucose are known.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 穿刺和拔管后她好转了，这只说明处理对她有效，说明不了液体是怎么来的：两步都做了，作用分不开，单凭积液消退也证实不了乳糜。
keyReasoning.en: Her recovery after the taps and the line's removal shows that this treatment worked for her, not how the fluid arose: both steps were taken, so their effects cannot be separated, and resolution alone cannot confirm chyle.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单个病例报告：不能证明PICC就是积液的原因，也不能说明是哪种机制，更不能说明按现行标准存在乳糜胸。本版的患者事实沿用1.0.0版的记录，尚未对照原文全文核对。报告的处理作为历史事实记录；决策、处置选项和评分依据现行指南设计，属于教学设计。生命体征、血气、呼吸支持参数、经导管输注的内容、喂奶情况、超声心动图、血管超声以及穿刺液的细胞和生化均没有记录。
boundaries.en: This is one case report: it cannot show that the PICC caused the effusions, which mechanism was at work, or that chylothorax was present by today's criteria. The patient facts in this version are those recorded in version 1.0.0 and have not yet been checked against the full article. The report's management is recorded as historical fact; the decisions, management options and scoring follow current guidance and are teaching design. Vital signs, blood gases, support settings, what ran through the line, milk feeds, an echocardiogram, a vein scan and the fluid's cells and chemistry are not recorded.

unknowns.zh-CN: 生命体征、血气，恶化前后呼吸支持的方式和参数（升级后是否插管），以及她在第 7 天时的体重。
unknowns.en: Vital signs, blood gases, the mode and settings of her respiratory support before and after the deterioration (including whether she was intubated), and her weight on day 7.

unknowns.zh-CN: 经PICC输注的是什么（静脉营养的葡萄糖浓度、氨基酸、是否含脂肪乳、输注速度），以及她是否已经喂奶。
unknowns.en: What was running through the PICC (the nutrition's glucose concentration, amino acids, any lipid emulsion, the rates), and whether she was having milk feeds.

unknowns.zh-CN: PICC的细节：导管型号、置入长度、定位片和之后各次胸片的拍摄时间及上肢位置、拔出的长度；有无导管造影。
unknowns.en: PICC details: catheter size, inserted length, the timing and arm position of the position film and the later films, the length withdrawn; any contrast study of the line.

unknowns.zh-CN: 超声心动图（心包积液、动脉导管、心功能）和上肢及中心静脉的多普勒超声。
unknowns.en: Echocardiography (pericardial fluid, the ductus, cardiac function) and Doppler ultrasound of the arm and central veins.

unknowns.zh-CN: 胸水的细胞计数和分类、甘油三酯、胆固醇、蛋白、乳酸脱氢酶和葡萄糖及同步血液值；穿刺的侧别、次数和总量；腹水是否穿刺。
unknowns.en: The pleural fluid's cell count and differential, triglyceride, cholesterol, protein, LDH and glucose with paired blood values; the sides, number and total volume of the taps; whether the ascites was sampled.

unknowns.zh-CN: 血培养、血常规、CRP、血清白蛋白、血糖和甘油三酯；是否用过抗生素。
unknowns.en: Blood culture, blood count, CRP, serum albumin, glucose and triglycerides; whether antibiotics were given.

unknowns.zh-CN: 积液和腹水消退所用的时间、拔管后的营养方式和静脉通路、是否再置中心静脉，以及 2 个月和 4 个月时生长发育是怎样评估的。
unknowns.en: How long the effusions and ascites took to resolve, how she was fed and given access after the line came out, whether a new central line was placed, and how growth and development were assessed at 2 and 4 months.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 导管优先：BAPM《新生儿中心静脉导管使用框架》（2015年发布、2018年修订）指出，带中心静脉导管的新生儿出现任何恶化，都要想到感染、外渗和心包压塞。床旁要做的是：支持呼吸，停止经导管输注且不冲管，拍胸片并做超声心动图，先取血培养、在决定治疗后1小时内用抗生素（NICE NG195，2021）。报告记录了呼吸支持升级；本病例没有记录超声心动图、血培养或抗生素。
teachingPoints.en: Line first: BAPM's framework on central venous catheters in neonates (2015, revised 2018) says any deterioration in a baby with a central line should raise infection, extravasation and tamponade. At the cot side: support breathing, stop infusing through the line without flushing it, get a chest film and an echocardiogram, and take a blood culture before antibiotics given within 1 hour of the decision (NICE NG195, 2021). The report records escalated support; this case records no echocardiogram, blood culture or antibiotics.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 尖端位置：BAPM（2018）要求所有中心静脉导管尖端位于心影之外，ESPGHAN/ESPEN/ESPR/CSPEN静脉通路指南（2018）要求尖端位于心包之外。椎体平面只是近似，各指南给出的标志不同；尖端还会随肢体位置移动，所以每次拍片都要记录上肢位置。她的尖端在第 3 胸椎下缘，之后的胸片描述位置同前——这不支持导管移位，但既证明不了血管壁完好，也证明不了静脉通畅。
teachingPoints.en: Tip position: BAPM (2018) asks for every central catheter tip outside the cardiac silhouette and the ESPGHAN/ESPEN/ESPR/CSPEN venous-access guideline (2018) for a tip outside the pericardial sac. Vertebral levels are proxies, and guidelines quote different ones; tips also move with limb position, so record the arm position on every film. Her tip at the lower border of T3, described as unchanged on later films, argues against migration but proves neither an intact vessel wall nor a patent vein.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 导管相关积液：怀疑中心静脉导管有问题时，停止经其输注、改用其他通路（INS《输液治疗实践标准》第9版，2024）；影响呼吸的积液在超声引导下穿刺，按mL/kg记录抽液量——报告每次抽 20–30 mL，约为她 1.1 kg 出生体重的 18–27 mL/kg（第 7 天的体重未记录）；拔除导管。中心静脉导管必须拔除时，可以短期经外周静脉给予肠外营养（NICE NG154，2020）。
teachingPoints.en: Line-related effusion: when a central line is suspect, stop infusing through it and use other access (INS Infusion Therapy Standards of Practice, 9th edition, 2024); tap an effusion that compromises breathing under ultrasound and record the volume in mL/kg — the report's taps of 20–30 mL were about 18–27 mL/kg of her 1.1 kg birth weight (her day-7 weight is not recorded); remove the line. When a central line has to come out, short-term peripheral parenteral nutrition is acceptable (NICE NG154, 2020).

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 乳糜还是输注液：儿童胸水在有经口脂肪摄入时甘油三酯 > 1.1 mmol/L、细胞数 ≥ 1000/µL且淋巴细胞 > 80 % 才诊断为乳糜（Büttiker等，1999）。乙醚试验只提示有脂肪——漏出的脂肪乳也会阳性；没有喂含脂肪的奶时，乳糜可以清亮；液体葡萄糖远高于血糖且细胞很少，提示输注液外渗。本病例记录的检查中，只有乙醚试验提示有脂肪；按现行做法，要等甘油三酯、细胞分类和葡萄糖结果再下乳糜胸的诊断。
teachingPoints.en: Chyle or infusate: in children, fluid is chyle at a triglyceride > 1.1 mmol/L with oral fat intake and ≥ 1000 cells/µL with > 80 % lymphocytes (Büttiker and colleagues, 1999). An ether test shows only fat — leaked lipid emulsion gives it too — and chyle can look clear without fat feeds; a fluid glucose far above the blood glucose with few cells points to leaked infusate. Of the tests this case records, only the ether test points to fat; today the chylothorax label waits for the triglyceride, the cell differential and the glucose.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 乳糜胸的治疗：先引流，再无脂喂养，乳糜仍持续时禁食并给予肠外营养，保守治疗无效才考虑胸膜固定或手术（Büttiker 1999）；Cochrane系统评价（2010）没有找到奥曲肽治疗新生儿乳糜胸的随机对照试验，无法作出实践推荐。这些都代替不了先把诊断弄清；本病例没有记录她的喂养是否做过调整。
teachingPoints.en: Treating chylothorax: drain, then fat-free feeding, then parenteral nutrition with enteric rest if chyle persists, with pleurodesis or surgery only when conservative treatment fails (Büttiker 1999); the Cochrane review (2010) found no randomised trials of octreotide for chylothorax in neonates and could make no practice recommendation. None of this replaces establishing the diagnosis first, and this case does not record whether her feeding was changed.

unknowns.zh-CN: 生命体征、血气，恶化前后呼吸支持的方式和参数（升级后是否插管），以及她在第 7 天时的体重。
unknowns.en: Vital signs, blood gases, the mode and settings of her respiratory support before and after the deterioration (including whether she was intubated), and her weight on day 7.

unknowns.zh-CN: 经PICC输注的是什么（静脉营养的葡萄糖浓度、氨基酸、是否含脂肪乳、输注速度），以及她是否已经喂奶。
unknowns.en: What was running through the PICC (the nutrition's glucose concentration, amino acids, any lipid emulsion, the rates), and whether she was having milk feeds.

unknowns.zh-CN: PICC的细节：导管型号、置入长度、定位片和之后各次胸片的拍摄时间及上肢位置、拔出的长度；有无导管造影。
unknowns.en: PICC details: catheter size, inserted length, the timing and arm position of the position film and the later films, the length withdrawn; any contrast study of the line.

unknowns.zh-CN: 超声心动图（心包积液、动脉导管、心功能）和上肢及中心静脉的多普勒超声。
unknowns.en: Echocardiography (pericardial fluid, the ductus, cardiac function) and Doppler ultrasound of the arm and central veins.

unknowns.zh-CN: 胸水的细胞计数和分类、甘油三酯、胆固醇、蛋白、乳酸脱氢酶和葡萄糖及同步血液值；穿刺的侧别、次数和总量；腹水是否穿刺。
unknowns.en: The pleural fluid's cell count and differential, triglyceride, cholesterol, protein, LDH and glucose with paired blood values; the sides, number and total volume of the taps; whether the ascites was sampled.

unknowns.zh-CN: 血培养、血常规、CRP、血清白蛋白、血糖和甘油三酯；是否用过抗生素。
unknowns.en: Blood culture, blood count, CRP, serum albumin, glucose and triglycerides; whether antibiotics were given.

unknowns.zh-CN: 积液和腹水消退所用的时间、拔管后的营养方式和静脉通路、是否再置中心静脉，以及 2 个月和 4 个月时生长发育是怎样评估的。
unknowns.en: How long the effusions and ascites took to resolve, how she was fed and given access after the line came out, whether a new central line was placed, and how growth and development were assessed at 2 and 4 months.
